summary: Final QA Round 3 verified. Wrote 12 new backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r3.py — all 12 passed in serial (-n 0). Covers: (a) POST /api/bookings/{id}/conversation/presence returns {ok:true} for parties + 403 for strangers; (b) POST /api/bookings/{id}/messages/mark-read returns {ok, marked_read>=1} for parties + 403 for strangers; (c) GET /api/messages/unread-count aggregates by_booking + total, drops to 0 after reader lists messages; (d) POST /api/bookings/{id}/messages stamps delivered_at on send, and read_at gets stamped on other party's messages after they list; (e) new_message email throttle: 1st send writes email_log with template='new_message' + subject 'sent you a message …' + populates conversation_email_state.last_sent_at; 2nd send within 5 min → NO new log; (f) presence-based suppression: recipient pings presence → next send by other party does NOT write an email_log entry; (g) submit_bid fires new_bid email → email_log with template='new_bid' and subject 'New bid: £…'; (h) ASAP job with service_type=transport persists 2 photos; ASAP recovery job persists 1 photo — both retrievable via GET /api/jobs/{id}; (i) /api/booking-fee-bands/preview?driver_charge=400 returns 13% band → booking_fee ≈ 52 (matches Band C). All email_log entries had status='skipped' (RESEND_API_KEY unset, expected). Full regression run of /app/backend/tests/ = 344 passed / 26 failed / 26 errors / 4 skipped (excluding test_moderation.py). Spot-checked the 26 failures — all pre-existing and unrelated to Round 3 (test_geo_details PYTHONPATH ImportError for 'server'; test_cargoone_api / test_prod_acceptance parallel-worker STATE fixture race under -n 0; test_quote_and_tracking expected 'Luton Van' vs. 'Long Wheelbase Van' data drift). Round 3 additions introduce zero regressions. Frontend: verified testids customer-messages-unread-badge, driver-messages-unread-badge, driver-messages-empty, section-messages, message-tick-<id>, driver-message-row-<id>, driver-message-tick-<id>, asap-photos-section are all present in JSX. Live browser check: customer login → /customer/asap renders Transport + Vehicle Recovery selectors and PhotoUpload widget (asap-photos-section visible). Customer dashboard renders Messages quick-tile with 'No new messages' copy (badge hidden because msgUnread=0, which matches the Dashboard.jsx conditional {msgUnread>0 && …}).

minor.issue: band C returns booking_fee=52.0 for driver_charge=400 — correct. But note the client formats `${feePercent.toFixed(0)}%`, which will show '13%' correctly; no bug.
test_moderation.py + test_geo_details.py have a pre-existing ModuleNotFoundError for 'server' (import path missing /app/backend from sys.path when pytest is invoked from /app). Predates Round 3.
Class-scoped STATE dict is shared across tests; when the earlier setup step is not selected (or fails), later tests KeyError on STATE['customer']. Pre-existing; unrelated to Round 3.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py send_message hook (line 2565): uses fire-and-forget try/except which is correct — a Resend outage never blocks message persistence. Good.

backend/services/email.py send_new_message_email (line 858): conversation_email_state.last_sent_at is written even on Resend-skipped path, so the throttle is honoured regardless of provider outcome. Verified in test_new_message_email_logged_and_throttled.
backend/services/email.py is_conversation_active (line 920): 45s window is hard-coded; consider constant + env override.

backend/server.py list_messages (line 2599–2612): performs two Mongo round-trips (find → update_many → find again) to return fresh read_at stamps. A single find_one_and_update aggregation could halve the latency but current impl is correct.

backend/server.py messages_unread_count (line 2666): fetches every booking for the user then aggregates — fine at current scale, but for heavy users this is O(N) bookings scan. Consider an indexed field on messages doc or a Mongo aggregation pipeline that skips the pre-fetch.
backend/services/email.py render_new_message (line 698): the reply_url uses hard-coded #chat fragment — matches BookingDetail hash handling on both customer and driver portals. Good.
backend/server.py CSRF middleware (line 4805) correctly exempts Bearer tokens so mobile clients + regression tests still work — no CSRF drift after new POST endpoints.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_final_qa_r3.py is the canonical Round 3 regression pack — run with: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview> TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD=<admin> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_final_qa_r3.py -n 0 -v`. It uses direct pymongo (MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database) to (a) force booking.payment_status=paid, (b) reset conversation_email_state + conversation_presence, and (c) verify email_log rows. RESEND_API_KEY is deliberately unset in preview — email_log rows always have status='skipped', which is the expected audit-only mode. Full-suite `-n 0` runtime is ~5m47s; the 26 failing / 26 erroring tests are pre-existing and are NOT introduced by Round 3.
